Okay something i would definetly be worry of is taxes although in switzerland its not as crazy as in other countries its defenitly smt worth considering. I highly suggest that inorder to manage your finances and plans properly you consult a proffesional (DONT GO TO A FREE ONE OR SMT OFFERD TO YOU BY YOUR BANK THEY WILL SELL YOU ON UNESCESARY STUFF) Try an accounting firm or a Tax consultant. It might cost you but trust me with that amount of liquid capital its definetly worth it. Also make detailed calculations on how much money you are going to need (i suggest you calculate with a rate of around 4% of returns anualy on your savings). I have worked in accounting before and what i have seen with clients is that its usualy best to stay as conservative as possible.

Good luck with your plans!
